function.name: search_legal_database
function.description: Search the legal database for statutes, regulations and case law. ALWAYS use for any legal question. Skip only for greetings or off-topic chat.

query.description: Primary search query in the jurisdiction's legal language

query2.description: Formal/statutory term for the same concept, in the jurisdiction language

query3.description: Optional: statute name + section if known
